_doc.purpose: App-specific patterns learned across runs. Makes repeat work cheap and consistent: the 3rd form with a mobile field reuses what runs 1 and 2 established, instead of re-deriving it.
_doc.authority: HINT ONLY — never an oracle. The Epic AC decides expected behaviour (AH Rule 19). A pattern only suggests WHICH cases to write and WHERE the element usually is.
_doc.staleness: AH Rule 30 applies. Every pattern carries lastVerified + source. Re-verify against live DOM before use; on mismatch, trust the DOM and update the pattern.
_doc.read_by: /test-case-creation (Step 3A — app-specific layer on top of the generic control matrix)

fieldPatterns.name: <e.g. mobile-number>
matches: <id/name/placeholder fragments that identify this field type>
standardCases: above max length via pressSequentially (BVA, AH Rule 18)

uiConventions.name: <e.g. inline-field-error>
uiConventions.rule: <e.g. validation errors render below the field in red, id pattern #<field>Error>

inconsistencies.observation: <e.g. login says 'Enter valid mobile number', registration says 'Invalid phone'>
inconsistencies.note: Same-concept text differing across pages. Report as a finding — never auto-normalise.
